name: Sternum Chin-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar using a shoulder-width or slightly narrower underhand grip with your arms straight.
Initiate the pull by depressing your shoulder blades and driving your elbows down and back while gradually leaning your torso backward.
Continue pulling smoothly until your lower chest or sternum touches or approaches the bar with your torso angled nearly 45 degrees back.
Lower yourself slowly back to the vertical dead hang with full control.
tips: Keep your chest proud and pull your elbows far behind your torso rather than rounding forward over the bar.
Control the descent smoothly as your torso straightens back underneath the bar.
